claims.text: The resort sits along the Miles River in the heart of St. Michaels, Maryland.

findings.quote: Inn at Perry Cabin offers casual luxury along the serene Miles River in the heart of St. Michaels, Maryland

claims.text: The historic waterfront retreat has roots dating back to the years following the War of 1812.

findings.quote: A historic waterfront retreat with roots dating back to the years following the War of 1812

claims.text: Samuel Hambleton designed the Morning Room after Commodore Perry's cabin on his flagship, which gave the inn its name.

findings.quote: built in the early 1800s by Samuel Hambleton
he designed the area of the manor that is currently known as the Morning Room after Commodore Perry’s cabin on his flagship, hence the name, Inn at Perry Cabin

claims.text: Rooms were designed by Alexandra Champalimaud, combining modern furnishings with nautical decor.

findings.quote: designed by renowned designer Alexandra Champalimaud to incorporate modern furnishing alongside nautical decor

claims.text: Each room has a waterfront view or a view of the property's garden.

findings.quote: each of which has a waterfront view or a view of the property’s garden

claims.text: French doors open to private decks, patios and verandas.

findings.quote: French doors open to the private decks, patios, and verandas

claims.text: The resort has a zero-edge pool and manicured gardens.

findings.quote: Additional highlights include a zero-edge pool, beautifully manicured gardens

claims.text: Complimentary bicycles, kayaks and paddleboards are available for exploring St. Michaels by land or water.

findings.quote: complimentary bicycles, kayaks, and paddleboards for exploring St. Michaels by land or water

claims.text: The property is a short walk from downtown St. Michaels.

findings.quote: Just a short walk from downtown St. Michaels

findings.quote: the Chesapeake Bay Maritime Museum which is a direct neighbor of the Inn at Perry Cabin

claims.text: Dogs are welcome, and guests with pets get a first-floor room with direct outdoor access.

Guests with pets will be given a first-floor room with direct outdoor access

claims.text: The fleet includes the historic 63-foot skipjack Stanley Norman.

findings.quote: the historic 63-foot skipjack, Stanley Norman

findings.quote: a fleet of five sailboats; a stately 55-foot Hinckley yacht

claims.text: The Spa at Perry Cabin offers plant-based treatments made from herbs and aromatics grown in the Inn's own gardens or on Eastern Shore farms.

plant-based ones inspired by the Eastern Shore, made from herbs and aromatics grown in the Inn’s own gardens or on Eastern Shore farms

claims.text: Baltimore-Washington International Airport is a 90-minute drive away, and driving from Washington or Baltimore crosses the Chesapeake Bay Bridge, which requires a toll.

Please note that you will cross the Chesapeake Bay Bridge, which requires a toll
